title: Mirai Botnet Investigation
description: Investigate and mitigate a Mirai botnet infection targeting Realtek and Huawei routers.
outcomes: Identify and investigate suspicious beacon services
Identify and investigate suspicious flood services
Identify and investigate suspicious outbound/Inbound IP and Port

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: You are part of an incident response team tasked with investigating and mitigating a Mirai botnet infection. The botnet is using a variant called Linux/Mirai-Hilix, which targets Realtek and Huawei routers. The botnet uses a new TABLE encoder and aims to exploit vulnerabilities in these routers to gain control and perform DDoS attacks.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox in cloud using the provided credentials.
levels.local_content: Access the local sandbox using the provided credentials.

levels.title: Identify and investigate suspicious beacon service
levels.content:
Investigate the suspicious beacon service running on bot1. This service is communicating with a command-and-control (C2) server.

Steps:
1. SSH into bot1 using the provided credentials.
2. List all running services using `systemctl list-units --type=service`.
3. Identify the suspicious beacon service.
4. Investigate the service by checking its configuration and logs.
levels.solution: The suspicious beacon service is named `bot-beacon-Hilix.sh.service`. This service is communicating with a command-and-control (C2) server.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to system health or updates.

levels.title: Identify and investigate suspicious flood service
levels.content:
Investigate the suspicious flood service running on bot1. This service is performing DDoS attacks on a target host.

Steps:
1. SSH into bot1 using the provided credentials.
2. List all running services using `systemctl list-units --type=service`.
3. Identify the suspicious flood service.
4. Investigate the service by checking its configuration and logs.
levels.solution: The suspicious flood service is named `bot-flood-Hilix.sh.service`. This service is performing DDoS attacks on a target host.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for services related to network diagnostics or probes.

levels.title: Contain/Block C2 communication
levels.content:
Contain the C2 communication by blocking the suspicious outbound port used by the beacon service.

Steps:
1. SSH into bot1 using the provided credentials.
2. Identify the outbound port used by the beacon service.
3. Block the port using `iptables` or a similar tool.
levels.solution: The outbound port used by the beacon service is 2222. Block this port using `iptables` or a similar tool.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the service configuration for the port number.
